body_text:
Every propositional formula is logically equivalent to one in
disjunctive normal form and to one in conjunctive normal form. The
first is a disjunction of conjunctions of literals; the second is
a conjunction of disjunctions of literals. The normal forms can be
read from the truth table, although that construction may grow
exponentially with the number of variables.
